images.title: Part of a part of a part
images.purpose: Show the shaded part is 1/4, then 1/2 of that, then 3/4 of that, which is 3/32.
images.composition: One large square in the centre, no clutter, one fraction line below.
exact_structure: Big square cut by one vertical and one horizontal middle line into 4 equal squares; outline dark #2B2B2B.
Top right square is lightly filled vermilion #D55E00 (1/4 of the whole).
Inside it a diagonal from its top left corner to its bottom right corner makes a triangle (lower left half) filled amber #E69F00: 1/8 of the whole.
The amber triangle is cut into 4 equal triangles by joining midpoints of its sides; 3 of the 4 are filled reddish purple #CC79A7, 1 stays amber.
Underneath one line with the product.
rejection: triangle not half of the top right square
not exactly 3 of 4 small triangles purple
images.description: A square in four quarters, the top right holding a triangle of which three quarters are purple.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the nesting from the whole square down to the purple part.

image_decisions.why: Nesting shows a fraction of a fraction of a fraction.
